ValidationRule.description: Throws error when Topic Type includes "Other" and Topic Type (Other Specify) is blank, for all PHOCS Case record types
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCFoodRecall", RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSComplaint", RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSEvent", RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSReportableIncident", RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSRequestsInquiries", RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSWaterAdvisories" ) && OR( INCLUDES(TopicTypes__c, "Other"), INCLUDES(ComplaintTopicType__c, "Other"), INCLUDES(IncidentTopicType__c, "Other"), INCLUDES(RequestTopicType__c, "Other") ) && ISBLANK(TopicTypeOtherSpecify__c)
